No adapted version exists, so nothing is wrong. Recording which commitments must be preserved is process advice, not an accessibility barrier in this form.
Focusing an unnamed div gives an announcement that varies by browser and screen reader. But the div contains an h2 and the error link, so 'nothing useful' and 'think they signed up' overstate it.
A plain fragment link scrolls the input to the top and can hide its label, hint and error above it. A real but small burden for zoom and magnifier users.
The title is unchanged on error and the inline message has no 'Error' prefix, so it can be heard as hint text. The focused summary partly mitigates this. Minor.
